name: Lou Lou’s Nail & Beauty Bar
about:
Lou Lou’s Nail & Beauty Bar is currently open and operating in East Tampa. Mins from I-75 and  centrally located. We’re so excited to bring our love and passion for all things nails and the beauty industry to the Tampa Bay Area.

Lou Lou’s represents more than just a dream, a passion, or a business. It’s named after my biggest inspiration and the first love of my life and now my Angel in heaven, my mother, Sarah “Lou” Wilson. 

Getting our nails and feet done was always one of the things me and my mom did together even into my adulthood, it was the way we chose to bond. So please know we take our business very personal!

If you tired of salons passing out poor customer service. You want to be serviced in a diverse and clean environment. You’re Looking for quality. Or all of the above. Rest assured you’ll find it here along with the good vibes to match.

Me and my team look forward to getting to know each and every person walking through our door. 

Come experience the difference for yourself, I promise you’ll leave in better shape then when you came 

-Tay “The Tayper’d Way”
